title: Flattening the Connectome Spectrum: A Spectral Filter for FC Induces a Pretraining Target for fMRI Encoders
abstract: arXiv:2609.37642v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Self-supervised pretraining reshaped prediction in language and vision, and brain foundation models (BFMs) inherited its promise. Representations learned from large unlabelled corpora should capture individual functional dynamics and generalise across cohorts. However, kernel ridge regression (KRR) fitted on functional connectivity (FC) matrices still predicts individual phenotypes more accurately than any BFM we tested. In this paper, we show that KRR is weighted by the eigenvalues of the FC which are miscalibrated for phenotype prediction. We apply an efficient spectral filter to recalibrate the eigenvalues of each subject's FC matrix, enabling the model to exploit more inter-individual variance. translated_title: 拉平连接组谱：一种作用于功能连接的谱滤波器为fMRI编码器诱导预训练目标
translated_abstract: 自监督预训练重塑了语言和视觉领域的预测能力，脑基础模型（BFMs）继承了这一前景。从大型无标注语料库中学习到的表征理应能够捕捉个体功能动态并在不同队列间泛化。然而，基于功能连接（FC）矩阵拟合的核岭回归（KRR）在预测个体表型方面仍然比我们测试的任何脑基础模型都更准确。在本文中，我们证明KRR是由FC的特征值加权的，而这些特征值对于表型预测而言校准不当。我们应用一种高效的谱滤波器来重新校准每个受试者FC矩阵的特征值，使模型能够利用更多的个体间差异。在我们测试的5个数据集、11种脑分区方案和6个预测目标上，我们的方法达到或超过了KRR基线。基于这一发现，我们随后在来自162个开放数据集的约4,000小时fMRI数据上预训练了一个小型编码器模型，借此对齐……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文发现核岭回归在FC表型预测上优于脑基础模型的原因在于FC特征值校准不当，据此提出一种高效的谱滤波器来重新校准特征值，并以此为预训练目标在约4,000小时fMRI数据上训练小型编码器，在多个数据集和预测目标上达到或超过KRR基线。
en_tdlr: The paper shows that KRR outperforms brain foundation models on FC-based phenotype prediction because FC eigenvalues are miscalibrated, and proposes an efficient spectral filter to recalibrate them as a pretraining target for fMRI encoders, which match or exceed the KRR baseline across 5 datasets, 11 parcellations, and 6 prediction targets.
